items.followUp: Write any two disadvantages of a flowchart.

rubric.why: Award for stating that a flowchart helps explain or communicate program logic.
rubric.description: States that a flowchart makes the logic easier to understand or communicate.

rubric.why: Award for a second valid advantage of flowcharts.
rubric.description: States that a flowchart helps locate errors or makes program planning or coding easier.
rubric.how: Accept one of these benefits, distinct from the first point.

modelAnswer: A flowchart presents the steps of a problem in a clear, visual form, making the logic easier to understand and communicate.
It helps to locate errors and makes program planning and coding easier.
